_comment: Public works: buildings the government raises in a province for gold, each giving the province a lasting modifier. cost: gold. tech: the technology needed. upgrades: the work this one replaces (it keeps the slot). requires.features: the province needs any one. modifiers: tax (province tax), trade_power (province trade power), levies (share of its people answering the levy), unrest (uprising chance), defense (siege length), research (points a month). A province has slots: one, plus one for every six units of people, to a limit of eight; an upgrade takes no new slot.

works.name: Temple
works.description: The gods are honoured and the tax rolls kept in their house.

works.name: Marketplace
works.description: A square where the province's goods change hands.

works.name: Barracks
works.description: Quarters and a drill ground for the levy.

works.name: Courthouse
works.description: The king's law, read out and enforced.

works.name: Academy
works.description: Scribes are schooled and records kept.

works.name: Harbour
works.description: Quays and warehouses for ships from afar.

works.name: Walls
works.description: A ring of stone around the town.

works.name: Great Temple
works.description: A house of the gods in dressed stone, seen from afar.

works.name: Bazaar
works.description: Covered streets of stalls where coin, not barter, rules.
